summary: Iter116 — SA CoParents Align link-from-account + Align read history + 'What professionals can see' attorney-approved wording. All 6 backend tests and all 8 frontend scenarios passed. End state as requested: parent1 LINKED, parent2 UNLINKED.
critical_code_review_comments: integration_routes.py `_link_status` emits last_read_at=reads[0].at (newest first) — correct. recent_reads capped to 5 via .limit(5) on sort desc. Good.
AlignLinkCode polls every 8s only while a code is showing; stops when `code` is cleared on auto-detect. No leaked intervals.
AlignReadHistory read list keys use `${r.at}-${i}` — safe even if two reads share a timestamp.

proVisibility.ATTORNEY_REVIEW_PENDING=false is a single-switch; `pros-see-draft-label` guarded correctly, `pros-see-review-*` tags never render (dead code path acceptable for a future re-review toggle).
